full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio photograph shows a young woman in dark off-the-shoulder clothing against a softly mottled gray backdrop. She is framed from the upper torso upward and placed slightly right of center, with empty gray space along the left edge. Her body turns toward the right, revealing a bare near shoulder and collarbone, while her head turns back to face the viewer. Dark hair is gathered high in a loose arrangement of curls and fabric, with stray wisps falling across her cheeks and brow. Her eyes look directly outward from deep shadow beneath the hair, and the parted lips remain softly lit. A broad black ribbon circles her neck and trails backward behind the right shoulder. The top edge of the dress sits low across her chest and upper arms, its dark gathered fabric and small decorative accents absorbing nearly all light. A pale area of skin arcs from the left chest toward the shoulder, separating the head and garment from the backdrop. The backdrop has a fine cloudlike texture but no props, text, or visible room boundary. Soft studio light comes from the left front, illuminating one side of the face, the collarbone, and the near shoulder. The far side of the face, dark hair, and right side of the garment fall into smooth charcoal shadow. Fine grayscale transitions give skin and fabric distinct textures: luminous smooth skin against velvety black cloth and a gently grainy background. The overall composition is intimate and restrained, using a turn of the head and selective light to make a quiet, direct gaze the center of the image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白影棚照片呈现一名穿深色露肩衣服的年轻女子，背后是柔和斑驳的灰色底面。画面从上身以上裁切，她位于中央偏右，左缘留有灰色空处。身体朝右转，露出靠近观者的肩和锁骨，头却回转直视观者。深色头发高高盘起，卷发与布料松散交织，几缕发丝落过脸颊和额头。眼睛从发下深影里直视画外，微张的唇柔和受光。一道宽黑缎带绕住颈部，在右肩后向后飘下。衣服上缘低落在胸前和上臂，深色抽褶布料与小装饰重音几乎吸收所有光。左胸到肩之间一道浅色皮肤弧线，把头和衣服从背景中分开。背景有细微云状纹理，却没有道具、文字或可见房间边界。柔和影棚光从左前方照来，亮起脸的一侧、锁骨和近肩。脸的远侧、深发及衣服右侧沉入平滑炭灰影。细腻灰阶过渡赋予皮肤与布料不同质地：发亮平滑皮肤对照绒黑衣料和轻微颗粒背景。整体构图亲密而克制，借回头动作与选择性光线让安静而直接的目光成为画面中心。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white studio photograph uses a broad matte gray field, velvety near-black masses, and carefully placed luminous highlights. Soft directional light shapes rounded surfaces with gradual transitions, while selected dark edges dissolve into the background. A close crop and generous side negative space keep the composition both intimate and balanced. Wispy fine lines interrupt larger smooth forms, giving the image delicate texture without clutter. The darkest areas remain rich rather than featureless, but they carry much less detail than the illuminated focal plane. A slightly grainy backdrop contrasts with polished highlights and soft fabric texture. The tonal range feels cool and restrained, with no colored accent and no hard cast shadow. The overall effect is elegant, moody, and quietly direct, using selective clarity and shadow to hold attention.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白影棚摄影使用宽阔哑光灰色底面、绒般近黑团块和仔细布置的发亮高光。柔和定向光以渐进过渡塑造圆润表面，少数深色边缘则消失在背景中。靠近的裁切与充裕侧向留白让构图既亲密又平衡。纤细飘线打断较大平滑形体，为画面带来精巧纹理而不拥挤。最暗区域仍丰厚而非完全无细节，但细节远少于受光焦点平面。略带颗粒的背景对照光洁高光与柔软布料纹理。明度色域冷而克制，没有彩色重音，也没有坚硬投影。整体效果优雅、阴郁而安静地直接，借选择性清晰与阴影留住注意力。
theme_en: A woman in black with a ribbon at her neck against a gray studio backdrop
theme_zh: 灰色影棚背景前，颈系黑缎带的黑衣女子
name: Peter Coulson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
